findings.summary: The diff adds `entry["kind"] = _item_kind(entry)` to `get_entry_summary` (the single-entry `GET /api/entries/{content_id}` endpoint), mirroring kind the same way the list endpoint does. This is a real behavior change beyond what SC-5 asks for (SC-5's given/when/then and its observation command both name only `/api/entries`, the list endpoint), and the new test file `test_api_kind_filter_integration.py` exercises only `/api/entries` -- no test in the diff calls `GET /api/entries/{content_id}` and asserts a `kind` field appears there. The underlying `_item_kind` helper is well covered through the list endpoint, so the risk is low, but the single-entry path itself is an untested addition with no journal record covering it either.
